title: Maximum Average Subarray II
summary: Given an integer array nums with n elements and an integer k, identify a contiguous subarray of length at least k with the highest average value.
statement: Given an integer array nums with n elements and an integer k, identify a contiguous subarray of length at least k with the highest average value. Return this average, with an allowable error of less than 10^-5.
constraints: 1 <= k <= len(nums) <= 10,000; values are between -10,000 and 10,000.
Return the maximum average of a contiguous subarray whose length is at least k, within 1e-5.
hints: For a guessed average, subtract it from every value and ask whether an eligible subarray has nonnegative sum.
Binary-search the answer and test it using prefix minima.
For each end at least k, compare its prefix sum with the smallest prefix ending at most end-k.
The feasibility predicate is monotone: every average below an achievable one is also achievable.
editorial: The feasibility predicate is monotone: every average below an achievable one is also achievable.

tests.explanation: The best eligible subarray is [12,-5,-6,50], averaging 12.75.
The length-one subarray [10] has the largest average.
